title: Pulse-pressure–pulse interaction does not improve cross-cycle prediction of urinary albumin-creatinine ratio beyond flexible component measures
abstract: In 4740 NHANES2007–2008 source and 4303 NHANES2017–2018 target adults, a fixed pulse-pressure by resting-pulse interaction did not meet the prespecified incremental prediction criterion for logUACR: target weighted MSE increased by 0.00062435 (0.0708%). Conditional95% interval [-0.0012400789930250122, 0.002376487789471987]; two-sample refit95% interval [-0.0016894871643835518, 0.0036395434193364886]. This is not an equivalence test or a refutation of vascular–renal associations.
